Wrapper function for the MetaCells2 divide and conquer parameters

params_sc_metacells2_dac.Rd

Wrapper function for the MetaCells2 divide and conquer parameters

Usage

params_sc_metacells2_dac(
  min_target_pile_size = 8000L,
  max_target_pile_size = 24000L,
  target_metacells_in_pile = 100L,
  target_pile_size = NULL,
  quick_and_dirty = FALSE,
  max_parallel_piles = 1L,
  groups_similarity_method = c("abs_pearson", "pearson"),
  rare_gene_modules = TRUE,
  rare_max_gene_cell_fraction = 0.001,
  rare_max_genes = 500L,
  rare_min_genes_of_modules = 4L,
  rare_min_cells_of_modules = 12L,
  rare_genes_similarity_method = c("repeated_pearson", "repeated_abs_pearson", "pearson",
    "abs_pearson"),
  rare_genes_cluster_method = c("ward", "complete", "average", "weighted")
)

Arguments

min_target_pile_size

Integer. Lower clamp on the derived pile size. Defaults to 8000L.

max_target_pile_size

Integer. Upper clamp on the derived pile size. Defaults to 24000L.

target_metacells_in_pile

Integer. Meta cells wanted per pile, used to derive the pile size. Defaults to 100L.

target_pile_size

Integer or NULL. Fixed pile size. NULL derives it from the data and clamps it to [min_target_pile_size, max_target_pile_size]. Defaults to NULL.

quick_and_dirty

Boolean. Stop after the final phase instead of regrouping the outliers. Defaults to FALSE.

max_parallel_piles

Integer. Piles computed concurrently. Each pile holds two dense pile_size x pile_size matrices, so this trades memory for speed. Defaults to 1L.

groups_similarity_method

String. Similarity used when grouping meta cells into piles. One of c("abs_pearson", "pearson"). Defaults to "abs_pearson".

rare_gene_modules

Boolean. Detect rare gene modules first and pile their cells separately. Defaults to TRUE.

rare_max_gene_cell_fraction

Numeric. Largest fraction of cells a gene may be expressed in to be a rare gene candidate. Defaults to 0.001.

rare_max_genes

Integer. Most rare gene candidates kept. Defaults to 500L.

rare_min_genes_of_modules

Integer. Fewest genes in a rare gene module. Defaults to 4L.

rare_min_cells_of_modules

Integer. Fewest cells in a rare gene module. Defaults to 12L.

rare_genes_similarity_method

String. Gene-gene similarity of the rare candidates. One of c("repeated_pearson", "repeated_abs_pearson", "pearson", "abs_pearson"). Defaults to "repeated_pearson".

rare_genes_cluster_method

String. Linkage for the hierarchical clustering of the rare candidates. One of c("ward", "complete", "average", "weighted"). Defaults to "ward".

Value

A named list with the following elements:

  • min_target_pile_size - Integer. Lower clamp on the derived pile size. Defaults to 8000L.

  • max_target_pile_size - Integer. Upper clamp on the derived pile size. Defaults to 24000L.

  • target_metacells_in_pile - Integer. Meta cells wanted per pile, used to derive the pile size. Defaults to 100L.

  • target_pile_size - Integer or NULL. Fixed pile size. NULL derives it from the data and clamps it to [min_target_pile_size, max_target_pile_size]. Defaults to NULL.

  • quick_and_dirty - Boolean. Stop after the final phase instead of regrouping the outliers. Defaults to FALSE.

  • max_parallel_piles - Integer. Piles computed concurrently. Each pile holds two dense pile_size x pile_size matrices, so this trades memory for speed. Defaults to 1L.

  • groups_similarity_method - String. Similarity used when grouping meta cells into piles. One of c("abs_pearson", "pearson"). Defaults to "abs_pearson".

  • rare_gene_modules - Boolean. Detect rare gene modules first and pile their cells separately. Defaults to TRUE.

  • rare_max_gene_cell_fraction - Numeric. Largest fraction of cells a gene may be expressed in to be a rare gene candidate. Defaults to 0.001.

  • rare_max_genes - Integer. Most rare gene candidates kept. Defaults to 500L.

  • rare_min_genes_of_modules - Integer. Fewest genes in a rare gene module. Defaults to 4L.

  • rare_min_cells_of_modules - Integer. Fewest cells in a rare gene module. Defaults to 12L.

  • rare_genes_similarity_method - String. Gene-gene similarity of the rare candidates. One of c("repeated_pearson", "repeated_abs_pearson", "pearson", "abs_pearson"). Defaults to "repeated_pearson".

  • rare_genes_cluster_method - String. Linkage for the hierarchical clustering of the rare candidates. One of c("ward", "complete", "average", "weighted"). Defaults to "ward".
